tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour (STL blue): dark bands, primary dark buttons, headings accent, the logo body. Carries on-band text (8.0:1).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Deepest band: the network map section, photo overlays, footer, label on coral buttons.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: The one signal colour: primary call-to-action fills, route lines, the logo slash, active markers. Never body text on white; text on a coral fill is on-coral.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Light blue tint: map dots on dark, quiet illustration fills, eyebrow text on navy.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Every page sits on white.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Quiet fill: input wells, chips, icon tiles, FleetTrack-style hero canvas.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, dividers, table rules.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on surface and surface-alt (15.8:1 / 14.6:1).

tokens.name: ink-heading
tokens.usage: Headings and card titles on surface and surface-alt (8.0:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, card descriptions on surface and surface-alt (5.6:1 / 5.2:1).

tokens.name: coral-ink
tokens.usage: Coral as text: eyebrows, container codes, numbered labels on surface (5.1:1). Use instead of coral for any text.

tokens.name: on-coral
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a coral fill (6.0:1). Coral buttons take navy labels, not white.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text on blue and navy bands and on photo overlays.

tokens.name: container-blue
tokens.usage: Illustration only: one of the container colours in the vector library.

tokens.name: container-steel
tokens.usage: Illustration only: steel, machinery and cargo greys.

tokens.name: container-white
tokens.usage: Illustration only: reefer bodies, cab panels, superstructures.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Status text and dots: delivered, cleared, on schedule (5.4:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-wait
tokens.usage: Status: awaiting documents, at anchorage, on hold (4.6:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-issue
tokens.usage: Status: delayed, inspection, rejected (8.0:1). Always paired with a word; never coral for errors.

module.note: The container module: cards are sized like containers. 1 TEU = a 20ft card, 1 FEU = a 40ft card (two TEU plus one gap).

tokens.name: teu-width
tokens.usage: Minimum width of a one-module (20ft) card in the bento grid.

tokens.name: teu-height
tokens.usage: Height of one container row (ratio 2.33 : 1, like an ISO 20ft side).

tokens.name: feu-width
tokens.usage: A two-module (40ft) card: 2 × teu-width + space-4.

tokens.name: rib-pitch
tokens.usage: Corrugation stripe pitch for container-wall bands.

tokens.name: casting-size
tokens.usage: Corner-casting square on framed cards.
